Subject: Steering committee: Exec sponsor + procurement prep

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the productive discovery session this morning. The team found Redwood's unified inference story compelling. To move this forward on our side we need to get a brief steering committee meeting with our exec sponsor and procurement to align on decision criteria, timelines, and any outstanding security/procurement asks.

Proposed attendees (FinIntegrate):
- Michael Reynolds (VP Product) — exec sponsor
- Tom Reynolds (CFO) — commercial owner
- Procurement team (copied)
- Jason Liu (Security) — to cover SOC2 / data flow questions

From Redwood we'd like to include a high-level exec and a technical lead to cover SLOs, architecture, and pricing.

Do you have availability next week for a 45–60 minute slot? Best windows for us are Tue/Wed mornings (PST). Also: procurement will need SOC2 evidence, network/data flow diagrams, and a proposed commercial band ahead of the meeting.

Thanks — if you can share a short agenda and a few date options I will coordinate on our side.

—Emily

Hi Emily — really appreciate the clear ask and the attendees list. We can absolutely get the right folks on our side and prepare a concise pre-read.

Suggested agenda (30–45 mins):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5–7 mins)
2) High-level architecture + data handling (10 mins)
3) Pricing band & deployment options (10 mins)
4) Procurement & security requirements / next steps (10 mins)

Dates we can offer:
- Tue, Mar 9 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed, Mar 10 — 09:00–10:00 PT

What would help us prep: the top 3 decision criteria your execs are focused on (cost, latency, data residency, etc.), and any hard procurement deadlines. We will attach a short steering-committee deck and our security evidence summary (SOC2 pointer + data flow) in advance.

Pre-reads / actions from Redwood:
- Steering committee deck (attached)
- Redwood security sheet (SOC2 summary, attached)
- Top-level SOW & pricing band (we'll include a draft SOW)

Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min — feel free to pick a slot or let me know your preferred time and I'll lock it in.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Thanks all — I'll assemble the pre-read and send before EOD Monday.
